flashcard_questions.q: The special rights and powers belonging to the monarch alone, including the power to call Parliament, declare war, and decide on religion and marriage.
Summer tours where Elizabeth and her court travelled around the country, staying in nobles’ homes.
A military force made up of ordinary citizens, called up in times of emergency to fight for the monarch.
Which group of about 19 trusted advisers met almost daily to help Elizabeth run the country?
Which local gentry officials enforced the law in each county?
